ModMetaData.name: Pick Up And Haul × Infinite Storage Fix
ModMetaData.author: nopphan
ModMetaData.description:
Stops Pick Up And Haul from looping on KV Infinite Storage ("Invalid count: -1 ... HaulToInventory" spam, and the deep job chains that can crash the game).
It also fixes an Infinite Storage bug on its own: vanilla's storage search ignores the storage's power check, so an unpowered Infinite Storage (solar at night, blackout, solar flare, or simply not wired) is still chosen as the place to haul to, every haul is rejected the moment it starts, and colonists retry forever ("started 10 jobs in one tick" spam). Haulers now skip any Infinite Storage that would refuse the item, using the same check the haul job makes.
Pick Up And Haul plans multi-item trips by counting free stack space in the target cell, but Infinite Storage stores items virtually, so that plan comes out broken and the job fails and restarts forever. With this mod, Pick Up And Haul keeps its multi-item hauling for every normal stockpile and shelf, while items whose best storage is an Infinite Storage are hauled by vanilla's one-stack job, which Infinite Storage is built for. Infinite Storage is also never added as an extra stop on a multi-item trip.
Needs KV Infinite Storage. The Pick Up And Haul part turns on only when Pick Up And Haul is also loaded. Load after both.
